```lean
theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (e : AddChar (ZMod N) R) (χ : DirichletCharacter R N) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ N) (he : e.mulShift ↑d = 1) {u : (ZMod N)ˣ} (hu : (ZMod.unitsMap hd) u = 1) : χ ↑u * gaussSum χ e = gaussSum χ e := by
  have h_char_u : χ ↑u = 1 :=
    by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Classical.choose (fun k => k ≡ 1 [MOD d] ∧ ZMod.coe_units k = u)
      have h_k : k ≡ 1 [MOD d] := hk.1
      have h_u : ZMod.coe_units k = u := hk.2
      rw [h_u]
      rw [ZMod.unitsMap_apply]
      rw [h_k]
      exact congrArg χ (congrArg (ZMod.mk _) h_k)
  rw [h_char_u]
  ring
```
